niger.title: Flag of the Republic of the Niger

colors.note: Represents the Sahara Desert in the north of the country.
Symbolises purity and the Niger River.
Represents the fertile southern regions and hope.
The orange disc represents the sun.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of orange, white, and green with an orange disc centred on the white band
- The near-square 6:7 proportion is unusual among national flags
- Adopted on 23 November 1959, before full independence from France on 3 August 1960
trivia:
- Niger's 6:7 ratio is the most nearly square of any African national flag
- The orange disc is traditionally centred on the middle band rather than placed at a canton
- The flag's colours evoke the land: Sahara to the north, the Niger River, and savannah in the south
- The design dates from the period of autonomous self-government within the French Community
